actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The lamia makes two Claw attacks. It can
replace one attack with a use of Corrupting Touch.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3)
Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: creature the lamia can see within 5 feet
actions.description: Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has the Charmed and Poisoned conditions.

bonus_actions.name: Leap
bonus_actions.description:
The lamia jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10
feet of movement.

at_will: disguise self (can appear as a large or medium biped)
